# Beantown Audio Rentals

> Boston & New England audio visual equipment rental and live event production company. Turnkey PA speaker systems, DJ gear, wireless & delegate push-to-talk microphones, HD laser projectors, 4K TVs, indoor 2.67mm LED walls, outdoor LED trailers, inflatable movie screens, wireless uplighting, cold sparklers, dry ice fog, photo booths, and silent disco packs.

- Canonical Website: https://beantownaudiorentals.com/
- Phone / Text: +1 (978) 601-5473
- Email: info@beantownaudiorentals.com
- Primary Service Areas: Boston (Back Bay, Seaport, Downtown, South End, Fenway), Cambridge, Somerville, Brookline, Newton, Waltham, Worcester, Cape Cod, Massachusetts; Providence & Newport, Rhode Island; Southern New Hampshire; New England.
- Hours: Mon–Sun 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM
